sell.metaDescription: Sell your Dubai property with EQT, a RERA-licensed prime brokerage. Discreet, off-market reach, evidence-based pricing from real DLD comparables, and a full-service transfer.
sell.intro: EQT sells prime and off-market homes across Dubai's most sought-after communities. We price on real evidence, market with discretion, and manage every step to a clean, timely sale, whether you list publicly or sell privately.

points.title: Priced on real evidence
points.body: We price from genuine Dubai Land Department comparable sales, not guesswork, so your asking price is credible from day one and defensible in negotiation.

points.title: Discreet, off-market reach
points.body: Many of Dubai's finest homes sell privately. We can market your property quietly to a curated database of qualified buyers, protecting your privacy and your price.

points.title: One accountable, RERA-licensed team
points.body: An exclusive mandate concentrates professional photography, portal prominence and negotiation in one committed party, which typically achieves a cleaner, faster sale.

points.title: Full service to completion
points.body: We manage the listing, viewings, the developer NOC, and the transfer at the trustee office, keeping your sale on track from first enquiry to final handover.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to sell a property in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Selling typically costs the seller around 2 percent agency commission plus 5 percent VAT, a developer NOC fee of roughly AED 500 to 5,000, and small transfer and conveyancing charges. The 4 percent DLD transfer fee is normally the buyer's cost, and there is no capital gains tax on the sale.

faqs.question: Can EQT sell my property off-market?
faqs.answer: Yes. Discreet, off-market sales are a core specialism. We can market your home privately to vetted, qualified buyers with no public listing, which suits high-profile sellers and prime homes.

faqs.question: How do you decide the asking price?
faqs.answer: From real, recent comparable sales recorded by the Dubai Land Department, adjusted for floor, view, size and condition. We show you the evidence behind the figure, never an inflated number to win the listing.

faqs.question: How long does it take to sell?
faqs.answer: A well-priced, well-presented home with a committed agent can go under offer within days to a few weeks, with completion following once the developer NOC is issued and the transfer is booked at the trustee office.

Compiled by EQT from public Dubai Land Department data and our own market experience. These are starting points for orientation, not valuations.

facts.label: Annual property tax
facts.note: No annual property tax in Dubai

faqs.question: What is the most expensive area in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills and Jumeirah Bay Island hold the highest values, where individual homes can exceed AED 100 to 200 million.

faqs.question: Are these prices exact?
faqs.answer: No. They are indicative starting points for orientation, compiled from public Dubai Land Department data and market experience. Actual value depends on the specific property, so request a valuation for a real figure.

faqs.question: How can I get an accurate figure for my property?
faqs.answer: Value it against genuine recent comparable sales recorded by the DLD. EQT prepares free, no-obligation valuations from real comparable evidence, usually within the hour.

about.metaTitle: About EQT, Dubai Luxury Real Estate Brokerage

about.h1: A private office for Dubai's prime market
about.intro1: EQT (EQT Real Estate) is a RERA-licensed brokerage focused exclusively on Dubai's most sought-after addresses: Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills, Al Barari, Jumeirah Islands, Downtown and Business Bay. We represent buyers, sellers and investors with the discretion, data and access the segment demands.
about.intro2: Since 2014, EQT has transacted more than AED 5 billion across over 1,000 deals in Dubai, a 12-year track record built on discreet, evidence-based advice.

principles.title: Off-market access
principles.body: A large share of Dubai's finest homes never reach the portals. Our relationships put private, pre-market opportunities in front of clients first.

principles.title: Evidence, not adjectives
principles.body: We advise from real comparable transactions and a verifiable sold record, not sentiment. Every valuation is grounded in data.

principles.title: Discretion by default
principles.body: Confidential representation for buyers and sellers who value privacy, from first enquiry to completion.
